tom: Quick - got an appeal from an employee who was passed over for a mid-cycle promo. Manager has resubmitted a comp-change but wants an evidence audit before pushing to Finance. What do we check?
rachel: For audits, look for 1) promo evidence (dates + concrete outcomes) 2) role doc/org chart 3) any prior exception memos 4) peer/skip-level notes if available.
alexa: Also check the original packet for discrepancies vs the new one. callouts: changed percentages, different start date, or conflicting HRIS IDs. We had one where manager edited the justification after initial submit which caused payroll churn.
mike: Finance add-on: ensure the run-rate math is consistent. include a simple table in the evidence doc: current comp -> new comp -> annual delta. If anything looks off Finance will reject.
tom: Is there a recommended audit checklist template? manager wants a short one-pager.
people-ops-bot: Template: 1) Evidence bullets (3-5) 2) Org snapshot attached 3) HRIS ID present 4) Run-rate calc present 5) Retro flag if applicable 6) Attach exception memos. See https://redwood-internal/templates/comp-audit
rachel: If appeal has new information (e.g., missed project ownership), capture exact deliverables + dates. Peer notes are helpful but not required.
alexa: If audit finds missing items, return to manager with a clear list and put the thread in "Pending Evidence". Use label: Pending-Evidence-Comp.
mike: For appeals with retro pay requests: mark "retro" and supply exact dates and a written explanation for delay. Retro >45 days needs CFO signoff.
tom: Timeline: can audit + resubmit get this into next payroll? payroll closes in 8 business days.
finance-bot: If you complete the audit and resubmit with approvals >= 5 business days before payroll close, high probability. Missing items push to next cycle.
rachel: ok i'll run the audit now and DM the manager the checklist. tagging this thread for playbook update (add an audit checklist).
alexa: If you want a quick review before send, ping me and i'll glance over the run-rate calc.
tom: thanks all. i'll update when manager responds. :thumbsup:
